guitar.evidence: Billy Squier is a guitarist-frontman known for playing Gibson Les Pauls and Stratocasters live in the early 80s MTV era; no single iconic signature instrument.
guitar.notes: Filled in based on general knowledge of his stage gear; not iconic enough for high confidence.

tone.target: aggressive mids-forward arena rock crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: aggressive mids-forward arena rock crunch with slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A punchy, mids-forward signal chain using a Plexi-style amp and 4x12 cab, enhanced with an OD boost for attack and chorus for sheen.
corrections: push it more sustained and bigger

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum.
Provide punchy pick attack and upper-mid boost without sounding like heavy distortion.
Add the required slight chorus sheen and sustain.
Establish the core arena rock crunch and sustain.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is generic; a Plexi-style OD might be better, but this provides necessary grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall/Plexi-style amp tone required for arena rock.
Provide the classic 4x12 cabinet sound associated with arena rock.
Boost the upper mids and overall punchiness as requested.
Add subtle sustain and depth without heavy reverb.
blocks.gap: The request was for 'slight chorus sheen' but also 'sustaining lead edge.' A light delay helps achieve the latter while keeping the tone focused.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and sustain without sounding like heavy reverb.
